verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a conventional OAuth2-secured REST API (v2) covering transfers, deposit addresses, conversions, and one-call orchestrations that mint or redeem stablecoins and move them on-chain. That implies developers call platform endpoints rather than running nodes. However, nothing in the evidence documents official client libraries in any language, and no published OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: documented client libraries/SDKs, explicit statements that gas/fees and node operation are abstracted away, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
